title: SEP Explorer
shortDescription: Free on-site security estimating for contractors.
fullDescription:
SEP Explorer is the free tier of Security Estimator Pro™ for security contractors.

Walk the site and capture:
• Projects with system counts (CCTV, doors, IDS, intercoms, cabling)
• Equipment catalog
• Labor rates that power every estimate
• Live material + labor + OH&P totals

Explorer limits (Free):
• 10 active projects
• 50 catalog records
• 20 labor records

Not included: drawing layouts, project management, or finance/invoicing.

Explore. Discover. Integrate.
releaseNotes: Initial SEP Explorer free-tier release for Android.
